records.title: Pennsylvania Legalizes Table Games
records.summary: Pennsylvania legalized poker, blackjack, and other table games at slots casinos to increase tax revenues.
records.significance: The legalization marked a major expansion of Pennsylvania's gaming industry, intensifying competition with neighboring states for gamblers' money.
records.sourceTitle: Pennsylvania Legalizes Table Games

records.title: France Enacts New Online Gambling Law
records.summary: France enacted Law No 2010-476 to open online horse betting, sports betting, and poker to competition under the regulation of the newly created ARJEL.
records.significance: This law broke the state monopoly on certain online gambling sectors while maintaining prohibitions on online casino games, establishing a new regulatory framework.
records.sourceTitle: Opening up of the French online gambling market

records.title: DOJ Reverses Stance on Wire Act
records.summary: The US Department of Justice released an opinion declaring that the Wire Act of 1961 only applies to sports betting, not other forms of online gambling like poker or lotteries.
records.significance: This landmark decision opened the door for states to legalize intrastate online gambling and lotteries.
records.sourceTitle: Justice Dept. Opens a Door on Online Gambling

records.title: Massachusetts Passes Expanded Gaming Act
records.summary: Governor Deval Patrick signed the Expanded Gaming Act into law, allowing for up to three destination resort casinos and one slots facility in the state.
records.significance: This legislation established a new regulatory framework and gaming commission, significantly expanding the commercial casino industry in the Northeast.
records.sourceTitle: Expanded Gaming Act

records.title: Horseshoe Cleveland Opens as Ohio's First Casino
records.summary: Horseshoe Casino Cleveland opened in the historic Higbee Building, becoming Ohio's first full-service casino.
records.significance: Marked the beginning of legal casino gaming in Ohio, creating 1,600 jobs and an expected $100 million in annual gaming tax revenue.
records.sourceTitle: Horseshoe Cleveland, Ohio's First Casino, Opens Its Doors To The Public

records.title: Nevada Issues First Intrastate Online Poker Licenses
records.summary: The Nevada Gaming Commission unanimously approved the state's first licenses for online poker systems, granted to Bally Technologies and IGT.
records.significance: A major milestone for US online gambling, allowing intrastate online poker and paving the way for technological advancement in casino operations.
records.sourceTitle: Nevada issues first licenses for online poker within state

records.title: New Jersey Legalizes Online Gambling
records.summary: New Jersey adopted an online gambling law (P.L. 2013, c.27), allowing Atlantic City casinos to offer online table games and slots.
records.significance: This legislation marked a major expansion of legal online gambling in the US, making New Jersey the third state to legalize it and setting the stage for significant new tax revenue and industry growth.

records.title: Nevada Launches First Legal Online Poker
records.summary: Station Casinos rolled out Ultimate Poker in Nevada, dealing the first legal online poker hands in the state.
records.significance: This launch represented the first operational, state-sanctioned online poker platform in the US following the DOJ's 2011 reversal of its Internet gambling ban.
records.sourceTitle: New Jersey, Nevada and Delaware Closer to Jackpot With Online Betting

records.title: Revel Casino Hotel Closes in Atlantic City
records.summary: Revel Casino Hotel in Atlantic City permanently closed its doors just over two years after opening, resulting in over 3,000 job losses.
records.significance: Marked a significant failure in Atlantic City's casino market and contributed to a wave of closures in the city during 2014.
records.sourceTitle: Revel, Atlantic City's Newest and Largest Casino, Is Closing

records.title: SLS Las Vegas Opens on Former Sahara Site
records.summary: The SLS Las Vegas officially opened after a $415 million renovation of the former Sahara Hotel and Casino property.
records.significance: Represented a major new casino resort opening on the Las Vegas Strip, revitalizing a historic location.
records.sourceTitle: First impressions: How far, how cool and how different is SLS Las Vegas?

records.title: Nevada Legislature Authorizes Skill-Based Slot Machines
records.summary: The Nevada Assembly approved Senate Bill 9, amending the Gaming Control Act to allow slot machine outcomes to be affected by player skill, directing regulators to adopt new technical standards.
records.significance: Paved the way for hybrid and skill-based games in Nevada, marking a major technological and regulatory shift for casino gaming devices.
records.sourceTitle: Nevada Legislature authorizes skill-based slot machines

records.title: New York Attorney General Declares DFS Illegal Gambling
records.summary: New York Attorney General Eric Schneiderman issued cease-and-desist notices to DraftKings and FanDuel, declaring daily fantasy sports to be illegal gambling under state law.
records.significance: Triggered a massive legal and regulatory battle over the classification of daily fantasy sports, significantly impacting the industry's operations in a major market.
records.sourceTitle: N.Y. AG declares DraftKings, FanDuel are illegal gambling, not fantasy

records.title: Wynn Palace Grand Opening
records.summary: Wynn Resorts opened the $4.2 billion Wynn Palace in the Cotai area of Macau, featuring a 28-story hotel with 1,706 rooms, 424,000 sq ft of casino space, and a 3.2-hectare performance lake.
records.significance: The opening marked Wynn Resorts' second integrated resort in Macau and significantly expanded luxury offerings in the Cotai Strip, representing a major investment during a transitional period for Macau's gaming industry.
records.sourceTitle: Wynn Palace

records.title: New York Legalizes Daily Fantasy Sports
records.summary: Governor Andrew Cuomo signed a bill (Chapter 237) legalizing interactive fantasy sports in New York, giving the New York State Gaming Commission regulatory oversight and imposing a 15% tax on gross revenue.
records.significance: The legislation resolved legal uncertainties surrounding DFS in a major US market, establishing a regulatory framework with consumer protections, age restrictions, and taxation benefiting public education.
records.sourceTitle: SUMMARY OF NEW YORK'S DAILY FANTASY SPORTS LEGISLATION

records.title: Pennsylvania Legalizes Online Gambling
records.summary: Pennsylvania Governor Tom Wolf signed Act 42 of 2017 into law, legalizing online casino games, online poker, daily fantasy sports, and authorizing new category 4 "mini-casinos" in the state.
records.significance: Pennsylvania became one of the first and largest states to legalize online casino gaming, significantly expanding the US regulated online gambling market.
records.sourceTitle: Act No. 42 of 2017

records.title: Australia Passes Interactive Gambling Amendment Bill
records.summary: The Australian Parliament passed the Interactive Gambling Amendment Bill 2017, completely banning offshore gambling providers from servicing the Australian market without a local license and granting the ACMA greater enforcement powers.
records.significance: The law fundamentally changed the Australian online gambling landscape by clarifying the prohibition of offshore operators and establishing a strict local licensing requirement.
records.sourceTitle: Interactive Gambling Amendment Bill 2016

records.title: US Supreme Court Overturns PASPA
records.summary: The US Supreme Court struck down the Professional and Amateur Sports Protection Act (PASPA) in a 6-3 decision in Murphy v. NCAA, declaring the 1992 federal ban on state-authorized sports gambling unconstitutional.
records.significance: The ruling paved the way for individual US states to legalize and regulate sports betting, fundamentally transforming the US gambling market.
records.sourceTitle: Murphy v. National Collegiate Athletic Association (16-476)

records.title: UK Slashes FOBT Maximum Stakes
records.summary: The UK government announced a reduction in the maximum stake on Fixed Odds Betting Terminals (FOBTs) from £100 to £2 to combat problem gambling.
records.significance: The dramatic stake reduction represented a major regulatory intervention to protect vulnerable consumers and significantly impacted the revenue models of high-street betting shops.
records.sourceTitle: Government to cut Fixed Odds Betting Terminals maximum stake from £100 to £2

records.title: UK Maximum Stake Cut on FOBTs
records.summary: The maximum stake on Fixed Odds Betting Terminals (FOBTs) was reduced from £100 to £2 following regulations approved by Parliament.
records.significance: Major regulatory shift aimed at reducing problem gambling, significantly impacting betting shop revenues.
records.sourceTitle: Fixed odds betting terminals

records.title: UKGC Fines Online Casino Operators £4.5m
records.summary: The UK Gambling Commission imposed £4.5m in penalties on four online gambling businesses for failings in anti-money laundering and consumer safety safeguards.
records.significance: Highlights stringent enforcement of compliance standards and social responsibility obligations in the UK online casino sector.
records.sourceTitle: Widespread regulator action results in further £4.5m in penalty packages for online gambling sector

records.title: Macau Casinos Undergo Unprecedented 15-Day Shutdown
records.summary: The Macau government ordered a 15-day closure of all casinos starting February 5, 2020, to curb the spread of the COVID-19 outbreak.
records.significance: This marked the longest shutdown ever for the world's biggest gambling hub and set a precedent for global casino closures during the pandemic.
records.sourceTitle: Macau casinos to reopen after virus outbreak forced shutdowns

records.title: Nevada Orders Statewide Closure of All Casinos
records.summary: Nevada Governor Steve Sisolak ordered the closure of all casinos and non-essential businesses in the state for 30 days starting March 17, 2020, due to COVID-19.
records.significance: The shutdown cleared the Las Vegas Strip and affected 440 casinos statewide, representing a massive disruption to the U.S. gaming industry.
records.sourceTitle: Nevada coronavirus: Sisolak orders shutdown of casinos, nonessential businesses

records.title: Netherlands Remote Gambling Act Enters into Force
records.summary: The Remote Gambling Act (Wet Kansspelen op afstand) officially entered into force, modernizing the Betting and Gaming Act to allow regulated online gambling and licensing.
records.significance: Established a regulated framework for remote gambling in the Netherlands, paving the way for licensed online operations.
records.sourceTitle: Staatsblad 2021, 45

records.title: Resorts World Las Vegas Opens
records.summary: Resorts World Las Vegas officially opened its doors, featuring luxury rooms and suites from three premium Hilton brands, representing the largest multi-brand deal in Hilton's history.
records.significance: Marked the first new integrated resort built from the ground up on the Las Vegas Strip in over a decade.
records.sourceTitle: Resorts World Las Vegas to Feature 3 Hilton Brands

records.title: US Commercial Gaming Revenue Tops $60 Billion
records.summary: US commercial gaming revenue reached a record $60.4 billion in 2022, surpassing the previous record set in 2021.
records.significance: This milestone marked the first time the commercial gaming sector exceeded $60 billion in annual revenue, indicating strong post-pandemic recovery and growth in the US casino industry.
records.sourceTitle: 2022 Commercial Gaming Revenue Tops $60B, Breaking Annual Record for Second Consecutive Year

records.title: European iGaming Market Faces Stricter AML and KYC Regulations
records.summary: Throughout 2022, European jurisdictions, particularly the UK, Germany, and Italy, tightened regulations focusing on Anti-Money Laundering (AML) enforcement, mandatory KYC at onboarding, and continuous lifecycle monitoring.
records.significance: The regulatory shift reflects a growing emphasis on player protection and compliance over rapid market expansion in mature European iGaming markets.
records.sourceTitle: Regulatory Trends Around the Globe

records.title: MGM Resorts Cyberattack
records.summary: MGM Resorts International identified a major cybersecurity issue that disrupted operations across its U.S. properties, leading the company to shut down systems to protect customer data.
records.significance: The attack highlighted significant vulnerabilities in casino technology infrastructure, resulting in an estimated $100 million negative impact to Adjusted Property EBITDAR for MGM's operations.
records.sourceTitle: Form 8-K: MGM Resorts International

records.title: Fontainebleau Las Vegas Grand Opening
records.summary: Fontainebleau Las Vegas, a 67-story luxury resort with 3,644 rooms and 150,000 square feet of gaming space, officially opened its doors on the Las Vegas Strip.
records.significance: The opening marked the culmination of a nearly 20-year development saga and introduced the tallest occupiable building in Nevada, adding significant new capacity to the Strip.
records.sourceTitle: FONTAINEBLEAU LAS VEGAS CELEBRATES GLOBALLY AWAITED GRAND OPENING WITH CEREMONIAL RIBBON CUTTING CEREMONY

records.title: Illinois Gaming Board Issues New Casino License to Wind Creek
records.summary: The Illinois Gaming Board issued a new casino owners' license to Wind Creek Chicago Southland in Homewood and East Hazel Crest during its final meeting of 2024.
records.significance: Marks the expansion of the Illinois casino market with the licensing of the state's 16th casino, fulfilling legislative goals for regional economic development.
records.sourceTitle: Illinois Gaming Board Licensed New Casino and Sportsbook Among Other Regulatory Actions During Final Meeting of 2024

records.title: Pennsylvania Gaming Revenue Surpasses $6 Billion
records.summary: The Pennsylvania Gaming Control Board reported that 2024 combined gaming revenue achieved a record high of $6.14 billion, crossing the $6 billion mark for the first time in a calendar year.
records.significance: Demonstrates the massive growth and economic impact of the gaming sector in Pennsylvania, fueled heavily by a 25% increase in iGaming revenue over the previous year.
records.sourceTitle: PA Gaming Control Board Reports Record High Gaming Revenue for 2024

records.title: New Rules Boosting Safety and Consumer Choice
records.summary: The UK Gambling Commission introduced new rules to increase safety and customer choice, including light-touch financial vulnerability checks and tightening age verification processes.
records.significance: These regulations represent a significant step in consumer protection, balancing consumer freedom with protections against gambling-related harm.
records.sourceTitle: New rules boosting safety and consumer choice

records.title: Gun Lake Casino Resort Expansion Opens
records.summary: The Match-E-Be-Nash-She-Wish Band of Pottawatomi Indians opened the $300 million Gun Lake Casino Resort expansion, featuring a 15-story hotel tower and a 32,000 sq. ft. year-round atrium called the Wawyé Oasis.
records.significance: The expansion significantly elevates the hospitality and entertainment offerings in the region, serving as a contemporary landmark and adaptable entertainment space.
records.sourceTitle: 2025 Indian Country Architectural Showcase

records.title: Indiana Bans Sweepstakes Casinos
records.summary: Indiana Governor Mike Braun signed House Bill 1052 into law, prohibiting online sweepstakes casinos that offer casino-style games through dual-currency systems. The ban takes effect on July 1, 2026.
records.significance: Indiana becomes one of the first states in 2026 to explicitly ban dual-currency sweepstakes casinos, reflecting a growing regulatory trend across the U.S.
records.sourceTitle: Indiana Signs Law That Prohibits Online Sweepstakes Casinos

records.title: BetMGM Reports Q2 2026 Financial Results
records.summary: BetMGM reported $711 million in revenue in Q2 2026, a 3% year-over-year increase, driven largely by its iGaming segment which generated $483 million in net revenue.
records.significance: Highlights the continued growth and dominance of the online casino (iGaming) sector for major operators like BetMGM, despite challenges in retail sports betting.
records.sourceTitle: BetMGM expects three US markets to consider online casinos in 2027
